instructions.body: Inventory and capture a legacy baseline before replacing externally visible WordPress behavior. Preserve route/content/SEO/form contracts intentionally.
Meaningful implementation requires an explicit migration plan/task packet and acceptance criteria. Planner owns architecture and policy; Builder executes bounded work.
Do not introduce a second router, state/data-fetching pattern, component system or rendering strategy without Planner approval.
Use the established token vocabulary and reusable patterns. Arbitrary values require a real one-off fidelity reason.
New icons are generated SVGs. No icon fonts, raster substitutes, emoji, or third-party icon dependency without explicit approval.
For public content routes, Planner must explicitly classify SEO/crawl needs and rendering strategy. Vue 3 does not imply client-only SPA delivery.
Preserve legacy copy by default. Content rewriting is separate scope and must be explicit.
Never move server-only secrets, credentials or privileged WordPress logic into client-side Vue code.
